evidence: The coated materials were analyzed using weight gain, X-ray fluorescence, X-ray diffraction, energy dispersive X-ray analysis, and scanning and transmission electron microscopy. These measurements revealed that the silica gel support could be conformally coated using reactant exposure times of ∼ 90 s. The ZnO loadings measured by XRF were quantified using standards prepared by mixing measured quantities of ZnO nanopowder with the appropriate Silicycle or Ineos fumed silica powder. The crystalline phase of the ZnO coatings was determined using XRD measurements with a Rigaku Miniflex Plus diffractometer. Cross-sectional samples for SEM and EDAX were prepared by embedding a small quantity of the silica powder in a conductive epoxy. The surface of the casting was then ground and polished to expose cross-sections of the embedded silica particles on the polished surface. These samples were imaged in the SEM and EDAX analysis was performed to acquire two-dimensional maps of the elemental composition for Si, C, O, and Zn. The quantity of ALD ZnO deposited on the silica gel was determined by direct weight measurements performed using an analytical balance with a precision of 0.5 mg. The ZnO loading was also measured by XRF using an Oxford Instruments ED2000.
